rules.description:
The HTTP client has been migrated to HTTPX2. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents or use the temporary, runtime-only legacy HTTPX escape hatch.
Validation concerns: No concrete replacement API has been established.
rules.evidence: HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and `httpx` is no longer installed automatically. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents or use the temporary, runtime-only legacy HTTPX escape hatch.
